items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide. Exact decision: block security-sensitive releases and new public exposure; conditionally allow ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no completed run; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secret handling, runtime isolation, release approvals and rollback, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. TLS reports no certificates expiring within 30 days, but configuration coverage is unverified. Compliance is incomplete, with open consent, banner, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. No active vulnerability or compromise is established; severity is high control-evidence uncertainty, not confirmed exploitation.

Retain the existing fleet security evidence work without creating duplicate requests or telemetry. Complete one consolidated read-only evidence record covering access boundaries, secrets exposure controls, runtime/container isolation, release and deployment provenance, dependency and supply-chain controls, TLS configuration, data flows and exposure, monitoring and incident response signals, and disclosure readiness. Preserve unknowns as unknowns; do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, deploy, add dependencies, or claim certification.
